mechanism: Phenobarbital is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases tretinoin metabolism, reducing tretinoin plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy; tretinoin is also a teratogen with high CNS penetration risk exacerbated by enzyme induction.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor tretinoin efficacy closely and consider dose adjustment; counsel on strict contraception as phenobarbital may reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness, increasing pregnancy risk with teratogenic tretinoin.
